headline:
Every bone.
A closer connection.
intro: A three-dimensional atlas of the adult human skeleton. Rotate, discover, and explore the anatomy beneath the surface.
controls: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to pan
touchControls: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom · Two fingers to pan
hint: Hover for a quick look. Select a bone to discover its anatomy.
regionalNote: Some vascular, nerve and developmental summaries describe the region; individual variation is expected.
education: For anatomy education, not diagnosis or treatment.
errorText: Check your connection and WebGL support, then try again.
helpBody: Rotate with the left mouse button or one finger. Zoom with the wheel or pinch. Pan with the right mouse button or two fingers. Search in English or Arabic, or browse the regions. Selecting a bone focuses the camera and opens its information panel. Press Escape to close the panel. Use the display controls to isolate, separate or reveal the mesh.
sourceGeometry: Original anatomical geometry. Teeth and cartilage are excluded; sternum parts are composed into one adult bone.
copyright: Designed for curiosity. Built for understanding.
attributionBody: The anatomical model is adapted from the Z-Anatomy-derived skeleton distributed by SeemaBansal1/3d-human-body-anatomy. Meshes were mapped to the standard adult inventory, transformed into their original anatomical positions, and recompressed. The derived model remains CC BY-SA 4.0. Source mesh provenance is supplied with the model.
clinicalReview: Educational summaries have not undergone independent clinical peer review. Consult the linked references for further detail.
